description: Remove a product from the merchant's catalogue. Takes the product ID ONLY — look it up with get_products and never guess. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the product: this also removes all of its variants and there is no undo. If several products match, list them and ask which one instead of picking.

productId.description: Product id from get_products — not a name

name: hub_delete_product
title: Delete product
